definitions.explanation: Additional notes or comments appended to a document, form, or record for supplementary information. Commonly seen as a section heading on official forms and documents.

examples.japanese: {備考|びこう}{欄|らん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in the remarks column.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{備考|びこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refer to the notes for detailed information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込|もうしこみ}{書|しょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{備考|びこう}{欄|らん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{特記|とっき}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If there are any special notes, please write them in the remarks section of the application form.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, administrative term commonly found on forms, documents, spreadsheets, and databases. Almost always appears as a section header ({備考|びこう}{欄|らん}) rather than in conversational speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {備考|びこう}{欄|らん} (remarks column/section)
- {備考|びこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{記載|きさい}→記載：14169_kisai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to note in the remarks)
- {備考|びこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{参照|さんしょう}→参照：11866_sanshou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to refer to the notes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注|ちゅう}→注：03434_chuu⟧: note, annotation (shorter, used inline)
- ⟦{注記|ちゅうき}→注記：22220_chuuki⟧: annotation, note (formal, in documents)
- ⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧: supplement, addition (broader in usage)
